about: The controllers openDJ looks after itself, beyond running Mixxx's mappings. beta: works on paper, waiting for someone to try it on the hardware. supported: tried on the hardware and its mapping settled. planned: no mapping yet. HID mappings (.hid.xml) have no picture or rows in the Controller Editor. Read by src/support.rs and website/tools/controllers.py.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX4
controllers.note: Tried on the hardware; the mapping is still settling.

controllers.name: Numark V7
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping from 2012. The V7 runs its own platter motor; the picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Allen & Heath Xone:K2
controllers.file: Allen and Heath Xone K2 - 2 Decks.opendj-mapping
controllers.note: openDJ's own two-deck mapping. Set the K2 to its factory settings: Latching Layers off, MIDI channel 15. Mixxx's mapping (Allen&Heath Xone K1/K2/K3) is still there to pick.

controllers.name: DJ TechTools Midi Fighter Twister
controllers.note: Tried on the hardware; the mapping is still settling.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-SX
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping. Four decks; the pads have Hot Cue, Roll, Slicer and Sampler modes.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-SX2
controllers.note: Mixxx's DDJ-SX mapping: the SX2 sends the same MIDI. CAPTURE and the sequencer buttons do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-RX
controllers.note: Mixxx's DDJ-SX mapping plus QUANTIZE: the RX sends the SX2's MIDI. PAD FX mode plays rolls. The Sound Color FX buttons, CAPTURE and the sequencer buttons do nothing yet; the COLOR knobs work as filters.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX6
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from Pioneer's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-RX3
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-REV1
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from Pioneer's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-1000
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from Pioneer's MIDI message list. The jog screens stay dark: they need Pioneer's own protocol.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX10
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from Pioneer's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-800
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from Pioneer's MIDI message list on top of the DDJ-FLX4's. The jog displays show BPM, time and the playhead. MEMORY, DELETE, the pad PAGE buttons and the COLOR FX buttons do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Native Instruments Traktor Kontrol S2 MK3
controllers.note: A USB HID controller, running Mixxx's HID mapping. No picture in the Controller Editor, and it can't be remapped there.

controllers.name: Native Instruments Traktor Kontrol S3
controllers.note: A USB HID controller, running Mixxx's HID mapping. No picture in the Controller Editor, and it can't be remapped there.

controllers.name: Native Instruments Traktor Kontrol S4 MK3
controllers.note: A USB HID controller, running Mixxx's HID mapping. Its two screens stay dark. No picture in the Controller Editor.

controllers.name: Native Instruments Maschine Mikro MK3
controllers.note: openDJ's own HID mapping for the Groove Box: steps, live play and recording, grooves and kits on the pads, with its screen. No NI software needed; quit Maschine first. No picture in the Controller Editor.
